description: 消防庁舎一覧 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 船橋市. 船橋市消防局の所管する庁舎の名称、所在地、連絡先の一覧となります。. Coverage: 船橋市. The portal files it under the publisher 船橋市. Its tags are 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-07-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
